description: The cabin of a private jet with walnut panels, brass reading lamps, oval windows and a dark blue carpet. A young man with long hair tied back, in a navy jumper, cream trousers and white socks, lies stretched out full length in a wide cream leather seat that reclines into a bed. He laughs, spreads his arms wide, rolls over on the seat and stretches out again with his arms flung out, because there is so much room. A soft blanket hangs down from the seat to the floor.

taps.phrase: to roll over on the seat

de.answer: Er hat reichlich Platz, um sich auszustrecken.
